name: message
title: 消息 Message
description: 用于在操作后提供短暂、轻量的全局反馈。

props.name: duration
props.description: Default time before dismissal in milliseconds.

props.name: maxCount
props.description: Maximum number of visible messages. Older messages are dismissed first.

props.name: offset
props.description: Distance between the viewport and the window edge, in pixels.

props.name: gap
props.description: Space between stacked messages, in pixels.

props.name: stacked
props.description: Stack messages as overlapping layers instead of a vertical list.

props.name: maxVisibleMessages
props.description: Maximum number of visible layers in a stacked queue.

props.name: scaleFactor
props.description: Scale reduction applied to each successive stacked layer.

props.name: expandOnHover
props.description: Expand stacked messages into a list on hover or keyboard focus.

props.name: dragToDismiss
props.description: Allow messages to be dismissed by dragging horizontally.

props.name: dragThreshold
props.description: Horizontal drag distance required to dismiss, in pixels.

props.name: motion
props.description: Motion defaults shared by all messages.

usage:
`MessageProvider` 与 `useMessage()` 用于由按钮或业务事件触发全局轻提示。Message 通过 Portal 渲染，适合保存成功、复制完成、轻量警告和可恢复错误等短反馈。

Message 只承载一行紧凑内容；需要标题、较长说明、尾部操作或长期保留的页面内反馈时，请使用 Alert。

默认状态图标来自 `@animateicons/react`，消息出现时会自动播放一次：信息使用 `InfoIcon`、成功使用 `CircleCheckIcon`、警告使用 `TriangleAlertIcon`、错误使用 `XIcon`。
